verdict.rationale: The official README lists "Debug issues and troubleshoot with natural language" as a core capability. It also documents on-demand debugging help by mentioning @gemini-cli in GitHub issues and PRs. Community reports of the tool getting stuck in error loops or failing tool calls lower confidence but do not concretely refute the debugging capability; one user credits Gemini review with catching real bugs. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs describing the debugging/troubleshooting workflow, hands-on independent corroboration of natural-language debugging in the CLI itself.
